name: Posted Margin Or Collateral 6
definition: Information on the posted margin or collateral of the transaction.

InitialMarginPostedPreHaircut.name: Initial Margin Posted Pre Haircut
InitialMarginPostedPreHaircut.definition: Value of the initial margin posted by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.|Where initial margin is posted on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of initial margin posted for the portfolio.

InitialMarginPostedPostHaircut.name: Initial Margin Posted Post Haircut
InitialMarginPostedPostHaircut.definition: Value of the initial margin posted by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.|Where initial margin is posted on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of initial margin posted for the portfolio.|Post-haircut values of margins depend on associated risk of changes in collateral value and therefore on the nature of the collateral posted (or collected).

VariationMarginPostedPreHaircut.name: Variation Margin Posted Pre Haircut
VariationMarginPostedPreHaircut.definition: Value of the variation margin posted, including cash settled, by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.|Where variation margin is posted on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of variation margin posted for the portfolio.

VariationMarginPostedPostHaircut.name: Variation Margin Posted Post Haircut
VariationMarginPostedPostHaircut.definition: Value of the variation margin posted, including cash settled, by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.|Where variation margin is posted on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of variation margin posted for the portfolio.|Post-haircut values of margins depend on associated risk of changes in collateral value and therefore on the nature of the collateral posted (or collected).

ExcessCollateralPosted.name: Excess Collateral Posted
ExcessCollateralPosted.definition: Value of collateral posted in excess of the required collateral.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
